purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.

queryOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic/local-language discovery queries are recorded in the city record. They found official general cartography, national urban-land agency information, and a university catalogue entry, but no evidenced Setif parcel endpoint.
requestOutcomes: GET/fetch attempt for the official Wilaya viewer returned HTTP 502. Fetch attempt for the official ASGA viewer timed out. The official ANFU page was readable and contained no public Setif parcel endpoint. The university catalogue page was not available from cache. No anonymous ID+geometry response was obtained.
